entities.span: A feature's own code lives in `src/features/<feature>/`.
Anything shared by two features moves to `src/lib` or `src/components/ui`.

```
src/
  app/
    (marketing)/        public routes, no session required
    (app)/              protected routes; its layout verifies the session
    api/                route handlers, only where an external caller needs HTTP
  features/
    <feature>/          that feature's actions, queries, components, types, schemas
  components/ui/        shared design system primitives (feature 5)
  lib/
    supabase/
      server.ts         request scoped server client, carries the user token
      secret.ts         the ONLY place a secret key client may be constructed
    ai/
      tiers.ts          tier to vendor and model map, checked in
      client.ts         the feature 13 router
    adzuna/
    result.ts           the Result union and the failure() constructor
  env.ts                validated environment variables
supabase/
  migrations/           hand written SQL, source of truth for schema and policy
docs/
  observability/        alert rule definitions, kept in git for review
```

**Amended 2026-08-29 by spec 0007.** This tree listed a fourth file, `lib/supabase/browser.ts`, "publishable key client", reserved for the OAuth handshake in feature 7. Feature 7 does that handshake entirely on the server, so the browser client never gained a caller and is deleted rather than left as a module whose doc comment claims a purpose it no longer has.
rejected_spans: The trail is kept here rather than the line silently vanishing: this project's data path is server only, and the one exception this file was held open for turned out not to be one.
